agreement_diagnostics: intent support-count distribution (5/5, 4/5, 3/5, 2/5, bare plurality) and the delivered intent accuracy within each stratum
entities kept and dropped by the support filter, by slot type, with the resulting false positive and false negative movement against the anchor
malformed sample count, and the rows where fewer than five samples parsed
rows whose delivered answer differs from sample 0
revision counts and the delivered Solver-visit index, against the anchor's five executed revisions
Reviewer task-contract tool calls, against the anchor's 1,082

arm.role: cell B2 on the anchor, five sampled Solver answers at temperature 0.7, commit s = 3 of 5

base_anchor.role: PRIMARY comparator and base, sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored

secondary_direct.role: SECONDARY comparator, the released TRAIN A direct anchor, sealed bytes

twin.flies_only_if: the arm's CI95 lower bound against the base is positive (owner decision 8)
twin.role: cell B2's greedy-repeat twin, five samples at temperature 0, same commit and same five seeds

authority.engineering: E2c (merged at 59db0f9b): the committed grouped-Solver answer is the one draft the Reviewer and the Planner read. The v2 package, registered before E2c, is superseded before contact.

claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split.

contrasts.role: primary, only once the twin has flown
diagnostic: what the aggregation alone buys
secondary, reported beside the base contrast

decision_rule.ADMITTED: CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta > 0 against the sealed anchor and, once flown, against the twin; intent non-inferior within 1.0051 pp; projection v3 same sign; no scenario intent loss beyond the null band
decision_rule.HARMFUL: an interval excludes non-inferiority on pooled SLU or on intent
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: non-inferior but not admitted; enters the default plan only if it lowers cost, which it does not

delta_convention: delta = arm minus comparator, in percentage points; negative is worse

estimators.commit_replay: analysis.native_commit_replay.replay_row over each sealed outputs row's solver_group, for the reported-only s in {2,3,4} sensitivity table
estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

metrics.estimand: per-row mean of joint scenario+action correctness

null_margins.source: TRAIN A OWN NULL measured by cell B0r: the CI95 half-widths of (B0r minus B0) on this same 1,080-row roster, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915, whole-speaker clusters. The imported DEV-1000 margins (intent 0.92, SLU micro 1.18) are NOT used.

roster_metadata.carries: sample_id -> scenario, speaker, headset, utterance_id; no text, transcript or gold filler
roster_metadata.speaker_key: spk:<usrid> from the governed SLURP release metadata, the 2026-09-09 own-null convention

resampling.seed_advance: paired_contrast advances the seed by the metric index; pooled metrics use the base seed
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed, each scenario resampled to its own size

projection_v3.applied_to: a COPY of each arm's sealed outputs, never the sealed bytes
projection_v3.role: owner decision 7: reported beside every official number. The symmetric-normalised number is NOT EVALUABLE on this roster -- no symmetric TRAIN sibling scorer exists -- and is reported as 'not evaluable' rather than omitted. Never used by the decision rule.

scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer

tables_required: headline: anchor (base), arm, twin, both deltas, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, scenario-stratified CI90, equal-scenario delta, and the released direct column
the projection-v3 column beside every official number, plus the symmetric-normalised number
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for every per-row metric, against the anchor and against the twin
per-scenario table, all 18 scenarios, natural mixture and equal weighting
the REPORT-ONLY offline sensitivity table for s in {2, 3, 4} at char-F1 0.8

cost table: contacts, contacts per row, Solver visits per row, REVISE rate, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, Reviewer tool calls, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, duty cycle, prompt-cache behaviour
